items.title: Kings become the last team this season to get a home win with upset of Celtics. First beam in more than 200 days. Keegan Murray game-winning putback. Darius Acuff with a jumper and two free throws down the stretch. Celtics took 59 3s but only made 13.
items.author: Anthony Slater
items.body_excerpt: Kings become the last team this season to get a home win with upset of Celtics. First beam in more than 200 days. Keegan Murray game-winning putback. Darius Acuff with a jumper and two free throws down the stretch. Celtics took 59 3s but only made 13.

items.title: Celtics got the miss, but no one blocked out and Keegan Murray put in the putback to put the Kings on top.
items.author: KeithSmithNBA
items.body_excerpt:
Celtics got the miss, but no one blocked out and Keegan Murray put in the putback to put the Kings on top.

Not sure why Devin Carter is on the floor there. That feels like getting too cute.

items.title: Keegan Murray just went coast-to-coast with no Celtics even making an effort to stop the ball.
items.author: KeithSmithNBA
items.body_excerpt:
Keegan Murray just went coast-to-coast with no Celtics even making an effort to stop the ball.

Thankfully Mike Conley is here, or Boston would be getting blown out.
